# Feature 010 — Plan (lean)

## Flow
Browser → Better Auth (`/api/auth/*`, email/password, sessions) → Riverbend session guard
(`auth.api.getSession`) → membership lookup (`shop_membership`) → existing tenant-bound services
(`IntakeService`/`OrdersService`/`BudgetService`) → forced RLS. Shop API keys + `/v1` are untouched.

## Technical context
- **Better Auth 1.7.16** (MIT), native **`pg` Pool** adapter (reuse the migrator Pool / a dedicated
  restricted role), `emailAndPassword` + `admin()` plugin, signup disabled. Tables in a dedicated
  **`auth` schema**, generated by `@better-auth/cli generate` and committed as a reviewed migration
  (`src/migrations/10000_better_auth.cjs`). No runtime schema mutation.
- **Mount order (Express 5):** `app.all('/api/auth/{*any}', toNodeHandler(auth))` BEFORE `express.json()`.
  (Express 5 uses named wildcards, not bare `*`.)
- **Riverbend tables:** `shop_membership(id, user_id text, shop_id uuid, role text, status text,
  created_at)` — FK shop_id→shops; unique `(user_id, shop_id)`. `auth_bootstrap(id bool PK default true,
  initialized_at)` single-row init marker.
- **UI:** server-rendered HTML strings in the `src/api` composition layer (no new framework; same
  pattern as the 005 web form — CSP + nonce + `escapeHtml`). Session guard + role/membership middleware.
- **Config:** `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET`, `BETTER_AUTH_URL` (base), trusted origins; Secure cookies when
  `NODE_ENV=production`. Portal enabled when the secret is set (fail-closed otherwise).

## Constitution check
I (code owns decisions) ✅ · III isolation: tenancy still from forced RLS via membership, never a body
`shop_id` ✅ · IV ports: auth behind our session guard; Better Auth is a reversible two-way-door lib ✅ ·
VII privacy: no passwords logged, HttpOnly cookies, no secrets in HTML ✅ · I7 no committed secrets ✅.
Deviation logged (D20): Better Auth identity tables are global (not tenant-RLS) — deliberate boundary.

## Phases
0. Install + pin better-auth; auth config; generate + review schema migration.
1. Membership + bootstrap tables; admin-init path (single-use); session guard + membership resolver.
2. Admin portal (login, shops, staff list/new/:id) via `auth.api` admin methods, allow-listed fields.
3. Staff portal (login/logout, dashboard, requests/:id, orders, needs-attention, usage) over existing
   services, escaped, prices from catalog only.
4. Security hardening (CSRF/Origin on own HTML POSTs, throttling verify, disabled/revoked rejection).
5. Tests (auth, authz, UI, regression) on real PostgreSQL; honest real-AI browser smoke.
6. Docs reconcile + converge + commit.
